<infobox theme="Disease">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Historical information</header>	
        <data source="createdby"><label>Created by</label></data>	
        <data source="dateengineered"><label>Date engineered</label></data>
        <data source="numberinfected"><label>Number infected</label></data>	
        <data source="numberkilled"><label>Number killed</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Biological information</header>
    	<data source="susceptiblespecies"><label>Susceptible species</label></data>
        <data source="transmissiontype"><label>Transmission type</label></data>
        <data source="incubationperiod"><label>Incubation period</label></data>
        <data source="symptoms"><label>Symptoms</label></data>
        <data source="treatments"><label>Treatments</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Disease|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
